children: A HEALTH BOOST FOR THE STOXX
is up 0.8%, getting a boost from healthcare names which are dominating the top ten biggest gainers in the index.
They are being led higher by Denmark-based biotech company Genmab
, which has jumped over 8% to its highest in around three years. Genmab and US drugmaker AbbVie
on Monday said their combination treatment for patients newly diagnosed with a type of lymphoma reduced the risk of disease progression or death in a late-stage study.
An index of European healthcare stocks (.SXDP) is up 1.%, on track for its biggest daily rise since mid-September.
The rise was enough to put it atop the biggest sectoral gainers, followed by media (.SXMP) and banks (.SX7P), which rose 1.4% and 1.2% respectively.
Oil and gas (.SXEP) was meanwhile the only sector to fall, down 0.2%, as Brent crude futures
were a touch lower on the day just below the $100 mark.
